contrast: word-count ratio (refined/original) vs composite-score change, Study 2 pooled (pilot + extension)
method: word ratio = refined fulltext word count / original fulltext word count (whitespace split); d_composite = mean over 5 dims of (refined judged score - original main-run judged score); per-run scores = mean over 3 judges x 3 prompt variants, dedupe last-wins per runId x judge x variant
note: Replaces MANIFEST-era P0 free check (r=+0.68, rho=+0.71, n=171); char-ratio variant gives r=+0.35 and is not the original metric. Paper v15 updated to r=+0.67, rho=+0.70.
